Update resolved mô tả hai khoảng ảnh hưởng: 15:49–16:48 và 17:20–17:55 UTC ngày 04-11; Actions, Pages, Webhooks, Code Scanning và Copilot coding agent gặp chậm trễ. On November 4, 2026, between 15:49 UTC and 16:48 UTC, and again between 17:20 UTC and 17:55 UTC, GitHub Actions, Pages, Webhooks, Code Scanning, and Copilot coding agent experienced delays. Delayed events were processed after mitigation.

This incident was caused by a configuration change to an internal event-routing service that unexpectedly paused delivery of several event streams. The change depended on feature flags that were not set up as intended, which the service did not handle gracefully.
